title: Resolve publication dates from HTML
description:
Extend publication-date resolution (reference_url_text.py PDF path, web_structured_metadata.py) to HTML: article:published_time, JSON-LD datePublished, <time datetime>. Run it in reference_curation.curate_reference so every Reference passes it (HN, email, hand-added, imports). Provenance in Reference.metadata.publicationDateResolution {source: og:article:published_time|json-ld|time-element|pdf|monitor|citation-year, precision: day|month|year, resolvedAt}. A monitor-supplied date is kept.
Tests on saved HTML fixtures; unknown stays null.
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
